skill.summary: Generates a comprehensive annual business report with financials, operations, strategic highlights, risks, and forward-looking guidance from your company data.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Annual Report Generator skill.
- Generates board-ready annual business reports from raw company data.
- Covers financial summaries, operational metrics, strategic highlights, and forward-looking guidance.
- Provides detailed report structure, benchmarks, and presentation tips for effective reporting.
- Includes useful financial formulas and industry benchmarks for SaaS and growth-stage companies.
